coordinate_system: Full1920x1080 pixels; x right,y down, positive eye-line angle clockwise.

recommended_anchor.method: Componentwise median of all140 observed poses, balancing maximum translation; numerical anchor, not replacement face image.

visually_useful_reference.finding: Eyes open, relatively level chin and relaxed mouth; short interval has stable position/roll. Use it to assess neutral appearance, but whole-clip median position avoids large one-sided translation.

smoothing_and_regions: Use robust temporal smoothing before computing correction; a 5-frame running median followed by a short symmetric 3–5-frame low pass is a bounded starting point.

Reject or hold scale through the blink near3.08s: raw eye distance falls to115.24px while the head image is not visibly shrinking comparably. Cap final scale correction to0.98–1.02 unless independent texture tracking supports more.
Keep eyes/nose/mouth/hair within one rigid similarity region. Blend into the upper neck and preserve observed background restoration; detector rectangle is not a matte.
Person masks alone also include hands/torso; restrict correction spatially to the head/upper-neck region so hand gestures remain unchanged.
limits: Similarity transforms preserve relative facial geometry within each frame but resampling changes RGB values; do not claim pixel-exact preservation.
2D similarity cannot remove3D pitch, yaw, facial perspective or eyelid/eyebrow accents.
Eye landmarks can move during blinks and are not rigid skull markers; aggressive scale/roll correction may create a pulse.
At20percent residual, a substantial increase in stabilization may look unnaturally anchored; evaluate the moving candidate.
Bounds use raw measurements plus a2percent scale cap, before temporal smoothing. Actual encoded output must be checked against its final configuration.
